transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... I’m here because people keep saying I’m not thinking right. My husband, and people at the warehouse. But I know they’ve been watching what I do, messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get moved up to supervisor.
Have you heard any voices that other people can't hear?
Sometimes... yeah. Like if I’m in the aisle at work, or just folding clothes at home, I’ll hear a man’s voice real clear. It says, Nicole, check it again. But there’s nobody there.
Do you ever find it hard to keep your thoughts straight or organized when you're trying to think or converse?

Yeah... sometimes. I know what I mean, but when I try to explain it, it comes out all mixed. Like I start with the forklift sheets, then I’m talking about church signs or my husband’s tone, and people say they can’t follow me.
Do you believe that people are actually watching you and messing with the pallet counts at work?
Yeah. I mean... I know how it sounds, but yes. They watch what I’m doing, and those pallet counts don’t just change by themselves. It’s to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Have you been having any problems with your daily routines or activities, like cooking, cleaning, or taking care of yourself?

Yeah... some. Work’s been worse. They took me off the forklift and the other stuff where you have to be real careful, because I was slowing things down with the counts and my routine.

At home... I still try, but my husband says he can’t count on me like he used to. I don’t really like talking about it.
Do you have difficulty completing tasks or do you often find yourself doing things in a disorganized way?

Yeah... I guess. At work I got stuck doing things a certain way, like walking around the pallets the same path again and again, and lining the labels up before I could move anything. My lead kept telling me to stop, but it was hard to just... move on.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious, depressed, or irritable lately?

Yeah... irritable, I guess. Some days I feel really fired up, like I can do everything and nobody can slow me down. But then my husband asks one little thing about the kids or my schedule, and I just snap at him... like he’s trying to control me.
Do you often find yourself repeating certain behaviors or actions over and over?

Yeah... mostly at work. I’d keep walking the same way around the pallets, over and over, and I had to line the labels up right before I could move anything. Even when my lead told me to stop, I... I had trouble just stopping.
Do you think the voice you hear is real?
I... I don’t know. It feels real when it happens. Like if I’m in the aisle or folding clothes at home, I’ll hear a man’s voice real clear saying, “Nicole, check it again,” and there’s nobody there.
Do you think the people watching you and messing with the pallet counts are actually out to harm you?

I don’t know if they’d hurt me, like physically... but yeah, I think they’re trying to mess with me. They watch what I’m doing at the warehouse, and the pallet counts change. Feels like they don’t want me getting that supervisor spot.
Have you experienced a significant change in your behavior or functioning over a short period of time, like a few weeks or months?

Yeah... I guess so. It got worse over a few weeks, maybe months. At work they took me off the forklift and the other stuff where you have to be careful, because my counts and the way I was doing things were slowing everybody down. And at home... my husband says he can’t really count on me like he used to.
Have you noticed any problems in your relationships with family or friends since these issues started?

Yeah… mostly at home. My husband says he can’t rely on me like he used to. And work’s been… not good. They took me off the forklift and some of the safety stuff because my counts and routines were slowing the line down. I don’t really talk about it much.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and behaviors that you and others have noticed as different?
Maybe… about ten months? It started after the arguments got worse, when I was trying to get that shift supervisor position. Since then it’s just been… different.
Do you often feel like your thoughts are racing or jumping from one idea to another when you're trying to think or converse?

Yeah… sometimes. It’s more like when I’m trying to explain something, it all runs together. I’ll start talking about the forklift sheets, then church signs, then my husband’s tone, and people say they can’t follow what I’m saying.
Have you noticed a significant decline in your ability to perform your job or maintain your relationships since these issues started?

Yeah… I guess so. At work they took me off the forklift and other safety stuff because I was slowing things down with my counts and routines. And at home… my husband says he can’t rely on me like he used to.
Do you often find it hard to stick to one topic when talking to someone?

Yeah… I do. I’ll try to explain one thing and then it kind of slips into something else, like the forklift sheets, or signs at church, or my husband’s tone. People tell me they can’t follow what I’m saying.
Do you often find yourself having trouble expressing your thoughts in a logical and coherent way?
Yeah… I think so. I try to explain what’s going on, and it jumps around—like from the forklift sheets to signs at church to my husband’s tone. Then people say they can’t really follow me.
Have you noticed any big changes in your emotions, like feeling really upset or angry for no reason?
Yeah… some days I feel really fired up, like nobody can slow me down. But then if my husband asks one little thing about the kids or my schedule, I just snap at him… like he’s trying to control me.
Have you experienced extreme mood swings in a short period of time?

Yeah… it can switch pretty fast. I’ll feel really fired up, like nobody can slow me down, and then my husband asks one little thing about the kids or my schedule and I just… snap, like he’s trying to control me.
Have you noticed a significant decline in your overall functioning since these issues started?

Yeah… I guess so. At work they took me off the forklift and anything safety-related because my counts and routines were slowing things down. And at home… my husband says he can’t rely on me like he used to.
